name: Sharma/Nepal family
summary: Santhosh Nepal (aka Phoshan Sharma) and his wife Aditi Poudel live in Ventura, CA with their daughters Saisha and Savana (Saani). They are originally from Kathmandu, and Santhosh loves practicing golf at Saticoy Golf Club. Saisha turns 16 next week and the family is hosting her Sweet 16 celebration on Saturday afternoon, Nov 07 2025, with relatives and friends.

name: Khadka family
summary: Divas Khadka and his wife Nisha Acharya live in Ventura, CA with their children Aryaman and Mahina. Divas is traveling with Mahina to Kathmandu, Nepal on Nov 18 and returning Dec 08 2025, and they maintain relatives from Charikot to Jhapa. Both Divas and Nisha are originally from Kathmandu.

name: Anup Rimal family
summary: Anup Rimal lives in Ventura, CA with his wife Pushpa and daughters Adi and Ashmi (Mimi). He runs the Himalya restaurant in Ventura and recently launched a mixed hospitality venture in Gyaneshor, Kathmandu, so he frequently travels between Nepal and Ventura.

name: Ventura Nepali community
summary: The Ventura County Nepali community includes families such as Surya Shrestha, BK Shrestha, Rajiv Upadhyaya, Dr. Rajendra Niraula, Dipak Neupane, Rajju Bajracharya, and Murari Das Shrestha. All hail from Nepal and now live locally with their families.

name: Tulsi Rai family
summary: Tulsi Rai is originally from Buipa village in the Khotang District of eastern Nepal. He currently lives in Camarillo, CA with his wife Kavita Limbu and their sons Noah and Nishan.

name: Nepal current affairs
summary: Nepal is facing political turbulence and corruption, pushing more than 85% of young workers toward low-paying jobs abroad—especially in Gulf countries and South Korea. Leaders like KP Sharma Oli and Pushpa Kamal Dahal (Prachanda) are criticized for rotating power without delivering transparent governance.
